_comment: Same-bundle bare references tools/bridge-imports.mjs leaves on the window bridge ON PURPOSE (v15-code-health-04). Each is stubbed as a global by the tests of the module that reads it, so an import would bypass the stub; converting one means rewriting those tests against the real module first. bridge-imports.test.js fails on any same-bundle bare reference NOT listed here.

ui/_entry-d.js.LibraryNav: screen tests stub it (the real one needs HomeBtn / NavButtons / TabsNavBtn from bundle-b)
ui/_entry-d.js.ScreenLayout: screen-routes tests stub it (the real one needs TabsNavBtn)
ui/_entry-d.js.GoToRefButton: FootnoteSheet / FootnoteListSection / ScriptureSheet tests stub it
ui/_entry-d.js.bookCategory: the real one reads index.html's _OT_BOOKS_INLINE, absent in LinkCard / nav-index tests
ui/_entry-d.js.buildSourceEndpoint: LinkPicker / VersePicker / excerpt-picker tests stub nav-index
ui/_entry-d.js.describeTab: TabsOverview tests stub tabs.js (the real one reads COL_BY_LETTER_SC)
ui/_entry-d.js.countItemWords: ReadingMinChip / index / History / progress-stats tests cover the counters-absent branch
ui/_entry-d.js.readingMinutes: ReadingMinChip / index tests cover the counters-absent branch
ui/_entry-d.js.SongCatalog: HomeScreen / About tests stub it with spies
ui/_entry-d.js.loadBibleStudies: HomeScreen / LinkPicker tests stub it with spies
